## The change

Exact pin `1.7.25` in **both** package.jsons (`apps/api`, `packages/db` — the only manifest
declarations; the `@better-auth/*` family is transitive). `pnpm install` regenerated
`pnpm-lock.yaml`: `better-auth@1.7.25`, `@better-auth/{core,drizzle-adapter,kysely-adapter,memory-adapter,mongo-adapter,prisma-adapter,telemetry}@1.7.25`, `@better-auth/utils@0.5.1` (0.4.2 gone); transitive `better-call 1.4.0→1.4.5`, `@better-fetch/fetch 1.3.1→1.3.3`. **No source line, no migration, no config changed** — the API surface we consume (`betterAuth`, `magicLink`, `APIError`, `createAuthMiddleware`, `getOAuthState`, `addOAuthServerContext`, field-name mappings, `accountLinking`, `rateLimit`, `advanced.*` cookie options, `trustedOrigins`) is unchanged at the types level and at runtime (suite below).

## Judgement calls + disclosures

- **Exact pin, not `^`.** The ruling says "exact matching pins" — both manifests carry the literal
  `1.7.25` (previously `^1.7.2`). Judgement: this is what "exact pins" means verbatim; it also makes
  future lockfile drift reviewable. If repo convention prefers ranges elsewhere, better-auth is the
  right place to be exact.
- **Orchestrator insert cherry-picked.** `9f171b99` (manifest row 266 + ticket file + `GD-SEC.R6`)
  lived only on `origin/stevevitali/rh0-sec-insert`; it rides this PR so `main` receives the insert
  with the work.
- **Unintended CDN invalidation, disclosed:** `cdn-invalidate-demo.mjs --help` runs the default act
  (no `--help` flag) — `/bff/p/demo~*` invalidated on `rhema-prod-urlmap-6f2b86e`. Sanctioned
  path, cache-only, self-healing, zero state; identical to the deploy's condition-8 call. Noted
  in the plan's §5.
- **Regenerated journey artifacts reverted:** the local sweep rewrote ~40 committed evidence PNGs +
  demo walk JSONs/`docs/demo-side-effects.md` (new local build hashes). Reverted — they are other
  tickets' evidence; my diff carries none of it.
- **`requireLocalEmailVerified: false` kept** — PRB.19's deliberate config; g38m-adjacent analysis
  in the verdict table; not weakened, not a new exposure.
- No secrets in any record; no prod artifact beyond the two `/healthz` bodies committed.
